name: Ore Placement Watch (TEST-ONLY)
description: TEST-ONLY diagnostic - remove after testing. Harmony-patches the base-game ore deposit generators (VSEssentials DiscDepositGenerator / ChildDepositGenerator / AlluvialDepositGenerator .GenDeposit) to log and skip ore placements that would index past a rock type's ore-block list or touch blocks outside the generating chunks, and suppresses exceptions thrown during ore placement so worldgen does not crash. Events go to Logs/oreplacementwatch-<timestamp>.log. /orewatch status (controlserver) shows counters.
